question: How can I track my order?
answer: You can track your order from the My Orders section of your account. Once your order has shipped, you will also receive an email with a tracking link. Tracking details can take up to 24 hours to appear after dispatch.

question: Can I change or cancel my order after placing it?
answer:
You can change or cancel an order while its status is still Processing.

1. Go to My Orders.
2. Select the order.
3. Choose Edit Order or Cancel Order.

Once an order has been packed or shipped it can no longer be changed, but you can return it after delivery.

question: I didn't receive an order confirmation email. What should I do?
answer: Confirmation emails usually arrive within a few minutes. Please check your spam or junk folder first. If you have an account, your order will also appear under My Orders. If you checked out as a guest and still can't find the email after an hour, contact our support team with the name and email address used at checkout.

question: An item in my order is missing or damaged. What can I do?
answer: We're sorry about that. Please contact our support team within 7 days of delivery and include your order number and, for damaged items, a photo of the item and packaging. We will arrange a replacement or a refund once we have reviewed the details.

question: Can I add an item to an order I've already placed?
answer: Items can't be added to an existing order. If your order is still Processing, you can cancel it and place a new order with all the items you need. Otherwise, please place a separate order for the additional items.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery usually takes 3-5 business days after dispatch. Express delivery usually takes 1-2 business days. Orders are normally dispatched within 1 business day. Delivery times are estimates and may be longer during busy periods or for remote addresses.

question: How much does shipping cost?
answer: Shipping costs depend on the delivery method and your address, and are shown at checkout before you pay. Standard shipping is free on orders over $50. Express shipping is available for an additional fee.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: We currently ship to selected countries. Available destinations are listed at checkout when you enter your address. International orders may be subject to import duties and taxes charged by the destination country, which are the recipient's responsibility.

question: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
answer: If your order is still Processing, you can update the delivery address from My Orders. Once the order has shipped, we can't change the address, but you may be able to redirect the parcel using the options in your tracking link.

question: My tracking says delivered, but I haven't received my parcel.
answer: Please check around your property, with neighbours and with anyone else at your address, as parcels are sometimes left in a safe place. If you still can't find it after 24 hours, contact our support team with your order number and we will investigate with the delivery company.

question: Do you offer next-day delivery?
answer: Express delivery usually arrives within 1-2 business days and is available for most addresses. Order before 2 pm on a business day for the best chance of next-day arrival. Available options and cut-off times are shown at checkout.

question: Is there free shipping during the holiday sale?
answer: During our holiday sale, standard shipping is free on all orders with no minimum spend. This offer applies only to orders placed during the sale period shown on our website.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept major credit and debit cards, selected digital wallets and store gift cards. The payment options available to you are shown at checkout.

question: Why was my payment declined?
answer: Payments can be declined for several reasons, such as incorrect card details, a billing address that doesn't match your card, insufficient funds or a security check by your bank. Please check your details and try again. If the problem continues, contact your bank or try a different payment method.

question: Is it safe to use my card on your website?
answer: Yes. Payments are processed over an encrypted connection by a secure payment provider, and we never store your full card number on our servers.

question: I was charged twice for my order. What should I do?
answer: Sometimes a payment shows twice because a temporary authorisation hold appears alongside the final charge. These holds are usually released by your bank within 3-5 business days. If you still see two charges after that, contact our support team with your order number and we will look into it.

question: How do I use a discount code or gift card?
answer: Enter your discount code or gift card number in the Promo Code or Gift Card field at checkout and select Apply. The discount will be shown in your order summary before you pay. Only one discount code can be used per order.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery, as long as they are unused, in their original condition and in their original packaging. Some items, such as personalised products, gift cards and opened hygiene products, can't be returned unless they are faulty.

question: How do I return an item?
answer:
1. Go to My Orders and select the order.
2. Choose Return Items and select the items and reason.
3. Print the return label, or save the QR code if offered.
4. Pack the items securely and drop the parcel off at the location shown.

Guest customers can start a return from the Returns page using their order number and email address.

question: Do I have to pay for return shipping?
answer: Returns are free if the item is faulty, damaged or not what you ordered. For other returns, a return shipping fee is deducted from your refund. The fee is shown before you confirm your return.

question: Can I exchange an item for a different size or colour?
answer: We don't offer direct exchanges at the moment. Please return the original item for a refund and place a new order for the size or colour you need. This is the quickest way to make sure the item you want is reserved for you.

question: Can I return an item I received as a gift?
answer: Yes. Gift recipients can return eligible items within 30 days of delivery using the order number from the gift receipt. The refund is issued as store credit to the recipient, so the person who bought the gift isn't notified.

question: How long does it take to get my refund?
answer: Once your return arrives at our warehouse, we usually inspect it within 3 business days and then issue your refund. It can take a further 5-10 business days for the money to appear in your account, depending on your bank or payment provider.

question: Where will my refund be sent?
answer: Refunds are sent to the original payment method used for the order. If you paid with a gift card, the refund is returned as store credit. Refunds for gift returns are issued as store credit to the recipient.

question: Why is my refund less than I expected?
answer: A refund may be lower than the amount paid if a return shipping fee applied, if original shipping costs were not refundable, or if a discount was applied across several items and only some were returned. Your refund confirmation email shows a full breakdown.

question: My refund was approved but I haven't received it yet.
answer: After a refund is approved, it can take 5-10 business days to appear, depending on your bank. Please check that it hasn't been shown as a separate credit on your statement. If it still hasn't arrived after 10 business days, contact our support team with your order number.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Select Sign In, then Forgot Password, and enter the email address on your account. We'll send you a link to set a new password. The link expires after 1 hour. If you don't receive the email, check your spam folder or request a new link.

question: How do I update my email address or personal details?
answer: Sign in and go to Account Settings. From there you can update your name, email address, phone number and saved addresses. For security, you may be asked to confirm your password before changing your email address.

question: Do I need an account to place an order?
answer: No, you can check out as a guest. Creating an account lets you track orders more easily, save addresses, view your order history and start returns online.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: You can request account deletion from Account Settings under Privacy. Before your account is deleted, please make sure any open orders or returns are complete. Once deleted, your order history and saved details can't be recovered.
